snippet.title: The Crab Is Walking - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist The Crab Is Walking now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5145940/The_Crab_is_Walking/ 

From Hypnohead Team, the creators of The King Is Watching, comes a roguelite city builder where your capital sits atop a giant creature crossing a post-apocalyptic wasteland.

Piece together buildings of different shapes on its limited shell, merge and upgrade your city, raise an army of over 100 unit types, and find combinations powerful enough to break the game.

Choose your Ride, choose your Rider, and decide how much danger you’re willing to crab into. The safe road is safe. But the hard road pays.

The Crab Is Walking is coming to PC. Playtests begin in 2027.

Follow us:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5145940/The_Crab_is_Walking/
